title: Daily Current Affairs — 3 November 2026
methodology: Items are dated by official release or reputable report date. Primary sources are preferred; reporting adds context. This is not a prediction of future exam questions.

items.headline: Exercise Tiger Triumph 2026: India–US tri-service HADR
items.summary: Indian and US forces conducted joint humanitarian assistance and disaster-relief planning centred on Visakhapatnam.

items.headline: Ninth India–Sri Lanka Coast Guard meeting at Mirissa
items.summary: The two Coast Guards reviewed search and rescue, pollution response, maritime law enforcement and capacity building.

items.headline: NITI Aayog launches India S&T Scoreboard for States and UTs
items.summary: Launched on 3 November 2026 in New Delhi, the platform combines science-and-technology ecosystem data (higher-education institutions, R&D institutions, deep-tech startups and incubators) with outputs such as publications and patents. It adds research-quality, impact, collaboration and open-access indicators across Academia, Government R&D Labs and Industry, supporting State/UT benchmarking and evidence-based policy.
items.sourceName: Press Information Bureau, Government of India
items.verificationStatus: PIB release dated 3 November 2026 and NITI Aayog dashboard reviewed; no unverified Meghalaya ranking or state-level numeric claim included.

items.headline: TRAI releases Telecommunication Interconnection Third Amendment Regulations, 2026
items.summary: TRAI's official index records the amendment under its Network, Spectrum and Licensing division. The full regulation is required to assess substantive changes.
items.verificationStatus: Official TRAI pages checked 4 November 2026; technical clauses not inferred from title.

items.headline: Indian Navy rescues 20 crew from fishing vessel Azini
items.summary: The Ministry of Defence reported that the Navy rescued all 20 crew members of the Iranian fishing vessel Azini off Somalia.

items.headline: COP31 scheduled for Antalya; COP30 roadmaps lacked consensus
items.summary: Reuters reported that COP31 is due to begin in Antalya, Türkiye, on 9 November 2026; Brazil's proposed COP30 roadmaps had not secured consensus.
items.verificationStatus: Reuters report dated 3 November 2026; proposals are not described as adopted decisions.
